name: baseline-grid-overlay
title: Baseline Grid Overlay
description: A proofing tool that overlays the document's baseline grid on any block of text and flags lines that drift off it — vertical rhythm made visible, with a drift count readout for CI-style typographic QA.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Swiss
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Toggle Inspect: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
